$comment: Every user-facing feature and where it lives in each app. A feature only one platform can have says why. freestash/tests/test_parity.py fails if a listed file is missing, a one-sided feature has no reason, or the two apps' navigation drifts apart. Add a row in the same pull request as the feature.

features.why: Browsers save one file at a time to their own folder and can't hash cross-origin files; the web Downloads page lists the same files and saves each .license.json.
